assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')['close'] for a in assets},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-05-30']
V=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')['volume'] for a in assets},axis=1).reindex(P.index)
r=P.pct_change(); ret10=r.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum().shift(1)
# continuation signal: lagged 10d return, confirmed by lagged abnormal volume, with volatility normalization
lv=np.log(V.replace(0,np.nan)); vz=(lv-lv.rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean())/lv.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
factor=(ret10*(1+0.35*vz.shift(1))).div(vol.replace(0,np.nan)).clip(-10,10)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for name,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-05-16','2029-05-30')),('recent180',slice('2028-11-16','2029-05-30'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(name,'obs',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals); print('decay',h,'obs',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290531_volume_confirmed_trend_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')['close'] for a in assets},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-06-27']
r=P.pct_change()
# Cross-asset dispersion reversal: fade each asset's recent return relative to the contemporaneous
# equal-weight universe move, scaled by its idiosyncratic volatility. All inputs lagged one day.
csmean=r.mean(axis=1)
relative=r.sub(csmean,axis=0)
idvol=relative.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
raw=-relative.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().shift(1)
factor=(raw/idvol.shift(1)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(-5,5)
rows=[]
for dt in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[dt],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15))
for name,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-07-01','2029-06-27')),('recent180',slice('2028-12-01','2029-06-27'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(name,'obs',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]
 for dt in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[dt],(P.shift(-h)/P-1).loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals); print('decay',h,'obs',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
out=factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna(); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290628_relative_dispersion_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-06-27']; r=P.pct_change()
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); tot=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); asym=(down/tot).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(.25,2).shift(1)
factor=(-r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().shift(1))*asym
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15))
for n,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-07-01','2029-06-27')),('recent180',slice('2028-12-01','2029-06-27'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(n,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 x=[]; fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(x);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290628_downside_asymmetry_signal.csv',index=False)

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')['close'] for a in assets},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-05-02']
r=P.pct_change()
# Downside-asymmetry reversal: recent losses are emphasized when downside volatility dominates total volatility.
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
tot=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
asym=(down/tot).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(.25,2.0)
factor=(-r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().shift(1))*asym.shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[dt],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',r.index.min(),r.index.max(),'obs',len(r),'avg_n',r.n.mean(),'coverage',r.n.sum()/(len(r)*15))
for name,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent180',slice('2028-11-01','2029-05-02'))]:

for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]
 for dt in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals); print('decay',h,'obs',len(x),'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1))
print('turnover',factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-07-11']; r=P.pct_change()
# Candidate: volatility-spread rotation. Prefer assets whose short volatility is low relative to
# their medium volatility, while retaining medium-horizon relative strength.
v5=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).std(); v30=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()
relvol=(v5/v30).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
mom=r.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum()
factor=(mom/(v30*np.sqrt(10))).shift(1) * (1-relvol.shift(1)).clip(-1,1)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for n,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-07-01','2029-07-11')),('recent180',slice('2029-01-01','2029-07-11'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(n,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 x=[]; fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(x);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290712_volspread_rotation_signal.csv',index=False)
# Revalidation of prior effective factor
asym=(r.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(.25,2).shift(1)
old=(-r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().shift(1))*asym
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([old.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
x=pd.Series(rows);print('OLD_REVALIDATION',len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-07-25']
r=P.pct_change(); m=r.mean(axis=1)
# Candidate: beta-neutral residual reversal. Remove each asset's rolling 60d beta
# to the equal-weight benchmark from its lagged 10d return, then fade the residual.
win=60
cov=r.rolling(win,min_periods=40).cov(m)
var=m.rolling(win,min_periods=40).var()
beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
resid10=r.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum().sub(beta.mul(m.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum(),axis=0))
factor=(-resid10).shift(1)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for n,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-07-01','2029-07-25')),('recent180',slice('2029-01-01','2029-07-25'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(n,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 x=[]; fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(x);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290726_beta_neutral_residual_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-08-08']
r=P.pct_change(); bench=r.mean(axis=1)
# Volatility-scaled short residual shock reversal: remove 60d benchmark beta,
# normalize lagged 3d residual return by 20d asset volatility, then fade shock.
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bench).div(bench.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res3=r.rolling(3,min_periods=3).sum().sub(beta.mul(bench.rolling(3,min_periods=3).sum(),axis=0))
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
factor=(-res3.div(vol.replace(0,np.nan))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for name,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-08-01','2029-08-08')),('recent180',slice('2029-02-01','2029-08-08'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(name,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290809_residual_shock_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Drawdown recovery: lagged distance above prior 60d trough, scaled by prior 20d vol.
# Use only through t-1; forward return t+1..t+5.
D={s:get_index_daily_data(s, days=1600) for s in U}
rows=[]
for s,df in D.items():
    if df is None or len(df)<300: continue
    x=df.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    p=x['close'].astype(float); r=p.pct_change()
    trough=p.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
    # lag everything, factor is recovery from trough: higher = recovered/strong; use bounded log ratio
    f=(np.log(p/trough)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
    fr=np.log(p.shift(-5)/p.shift(-1))
    z=pd.DataFrame({'symbol':s,'factor':f,'fwd':fr})
    z=z.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'date'}); rows.append(z)
a=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).dropna()
# dates with >=8 names
ics=[]; ranks=[]
for dt,g in a.groupby('date'):
    if len(g)>=8 and g['factor'].nunique()>1 and g['fwd'].nunique()>1:
        ics.append(g['factor'].corr(g['fwd'],method='spearman'))
        ranks.append((dt,g[['symbol','factor']].sort_values('factor')['symbol'].tolist()))
ics=pd.Series(ics).dropna()
# turnover: average rank ordering changes per asset across adjacent observations (approx signal sign/rank changes)
piv=a.pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='factor').rank(axis=1,pct=True)
to=piv.diff().abs().mean().mean()
print('dates',len(ics),'avg instruments',round(a.groupby('date').size().loc[a.groupby('date').size()>=8].mean(),2),'coverage',round(len(a)/(sum(len(x.dropna()) for x in D.values() if x is not None)*1.0),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    rr=[]
    for s,df in D.items():
        if df is None: continue
        p=df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')['close'].astype(float); r=p.pct_change(); trough=p.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); f=(np.log(p/trough)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1); fr=np.log(p.shift(-h)/p.shift(-1)); rr.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':p.index,'factor':f,'fwd':fr}))
    q=pd.concat([z.dropna() for z in rr]); out=[]
    for dt,g in q.groupby('date'):
        if len(g)>=8 and g.factor.nunique()>1 and g.fwd.nunique()>1: out.append(g.factor.corr(g.fwd,method='spearman'))
    ss=pd.Series(out).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(ss.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(ss.mean()/ss.std(),6),'hit',round((ss>0).mean(),4),'n',len(ss))
print('turnover',round(float(to),6))
# regimes for 5d from original dates
for name,mask in [('2026',ics.index.year==2026),('2027-28',ics.index.year.isin([2027,2028])),('recent360',ics.index>=ics.index.max()-pd.Timedelta(days=360)),('recent180',ics.index>=ics.index.max()-pd.Timedelta(days=180))]:
 ss=ics[mask]; print(name,'n',len(ss),'IC',round(ss.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(ss.mean()/ss.std(),6) if ss.std()>0 else None)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-09-05']
r=P.pct_change(); b=r.mean(axis=1)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(b).div(b.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().sub(beta.mul(b.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(),axis=0))
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# fade only negative residual shocks; neutral/positive observations are excluded
raw=(-res.div(vol.replace(0,np.nan))).shift(1)
factor=raw.where(raw>0)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-5)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for nm,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-09-05','2029-09-05')),('recent180',slice('2029-03-01','2029-09-05'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(nm,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[];fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290906_downside_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-09-05']
r=P.pct_change(); b=r.mean(axis=1)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(b).div(b.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().sub(beta.mul(b.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(),axis=0))
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Continuous volatility-scaled beta-neutral residual reversal, lagged one day.
factor=(-res.div(vol.replace(0,np.nan))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],(P.shift(-10)/P-1).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.sum()/(len(R)*15),4))
for nm,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-09-05','2029-09-05')),('recent180',slice('2029-03-01','2029-09-05'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(nm,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[];fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290906_continuous_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

cs=[]
for f in glob.glob('scripts/*_signal.csv'):

 except: pass

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-09-19']
r=P.pct_change(); b=r.mean(axis=1)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(b).div(b.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().sub(beta.mul(b.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(),axis=0))
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
base=(-res.div(vol.replace(0,np.nan)))
# Regime gate: lagged 20d breadth, reversing the residual signal in weak-breadth regimes.
breadth=(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean().mean(axis=1)
gate=np.where(breadth.shift(1)>=0.5,1.0,-1.0)
factor=base.mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('period',R.index.min(),R.index.max(),'obs',len(R),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4))
for nm,q in [('full',slice(None)),('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('recent360',slice('2028-09-19','2029-09-19')),('recent180',slice('2029-03-01','2029-09-19'))]:
 x=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(nm,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round((x>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([factor.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=pd.Series(vals);print('decay',h,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
factor.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290920_breadth_gated_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-09-19']
r=P.pct_change()
# Volatility shock: unusually high recent realized volatility tends to mean revert.

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-09-20

### Explored Factors

1. **Breadth-gated beta-neutral residual reversal**
   - Started with the existing 5-day beta-neutral residual reversal, volatility-scaled by 20-day realized volatility and lagged one day.
   - Tested two breadth conditions:
     - Flip the signal when lagged 20-day market breadth was weak.
     - Activate the reversal only during weak-breadth regimes.
   - Motivation: residual reversals may behave differently during broad market stress.

2. **Short-term volatility-shock reversal**
   - Defined as the negative lagged ratio of 5-day realized volatility to 60-day realized volatility.
   - Motivation: unusually high recent volatility may identify assets vulnerable to subsequent mean reversion.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | Observations | Avg. instruments | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Breadth-flipped residual reversal | 10d | -0.046241 | -0.153845 | 805 | 11.02 | 73.45% | 0.112838 | Failed |
| Weak-breadth active residual reversal | 10d | 0.046241 | 0.153845 | 811* | 11.04 | 73.57% | 0.112340 | Passed numerically, redundant |
| Volatility-shock reversal | 10d | -0.003839 | -0.014293 | 805 | 12.16 | 81.06% | 0.104101 | Failed |

\*The active-regime implementation produced several constant-signal dates and associated correlation warnings. Its apparent positive result is effectively a re-expression of the existing continuous residual-reversal signal rather than independent evidence.

#### Breadth-gated residual reversal decay

- 1d IC: approximately -0.029934 for the breadth-flipped version
- 5d IC: -0.044068
- 10d IC: -0.046241
- 20d IC: -0.021341

The active-only version reproduced the existing residual-reversal profile:

- 1d IC: 0.029934
- 5d IC: 0.044068
- 10d IC: 0.046241
- 20d IC: 0.021341

#### Regime observations

For the active-only residual formulation:

- 2026: IC 0.052284, ICIR 0.186973
- 2027–2028: IC 0.051021, ICIR 0.171577
- Recent 360 days: IC 0.026371, ICIR 0.084464
- Recent 180 days: IC -0.000135, ICIR -0.000446

The factor remains historically effective but has lost predictive strength recently. The breadth flip produced the exact opposite sign and therefore does not provide a useful independent improvement.

The volatility-shock factor showed some recent improvement:

- Recent 360 days: IC 0.051060, ICIR 0.186382
- Recent 180 days: IC 0.081274, ICIR 0.300744

However, its full-history IC and ICIR were well below the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840.

### Persistence Actions

- **No new factor persisted.**
- The breadth-gated residual candidate was not persisted because it is materially redundant with the existing residual-reversal family and the active-only implementation generated constant-signal observations.
- The volatility-shock reversal was rejected because it failed the full-sample IC and ICIR admission gates.
- No live-account, backtest, or step operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The current factor library remains unchanged from the latest validated ensemble.

The residual-reversal family remains historically effective but should remain capped because:

- Its recent 180-day IC is approximately zero or negative.
- The candidate variants exhibit near-perfect redundancy with existing residual-reversal artifacts.
- Recent live performance has been weak, particularly under the current stress regime.

### Plans

- Continue monitoring the volatility-shock factor as a research-only candidate because of its strong recent-window behavior.
- Test volatility-shock reversal at 5-day and conditional 20-day horizons with non-constant regime handling.
- Explore breadth as a weighting or confidence adjustment rather than a hard sign flip or zero activation rule.
- Revalidate existing residual-reversal factors on the next cycle and consider deprecation if recent performance remains below admission standards.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-03']
r=P.pct_change(); down=r.where(r<0)
v5=down.rolling(5,min_periods=3).std(); v60=down.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()
f=(-v5/v60).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('candidate downside-volatility-shock reversal')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-10-03','2029-10-03')),('r180',slice('2029-04-03','2029-10-03'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291004_downside_vol_shock_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-03']
r=P.pct_change(); neg=r.clip(upper=0)
# Downside semideviation ratio; zeros retained, requiring only modest history.
v10=np.sqrt((neg**2).rolling(10,min_periods=7).mean()); v60=np.sqrt((neg**2).rolling(60,min_periods=35).mean())
f=(-v10/v60).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('candidate downside semivolatility shock reversal')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-10-03','2029-10-03')),('r180',slice('2029-04-03','2029-10-03'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291004_downside_semivol_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date') for a in A}
P=pd.concat({a:d.close for a,d in D.items()},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-03']; V=pd.concat({a:d.volume for a,d in D.items()},axis=1).reindex(P.index)
r=P.pct_change(); volz=(V/V.rolling(20,min_periods=10).median()-1)
# Lagged price shock weighted by abnormal volume: high-volume selloffs are expected to revert.
f=(-r*volz).shift(1); fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1; rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
print('obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-10-03','2029-10-03')),('r180',slice('2029-04-03','2029-10-03'))]:
 y=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291004_volume_shock_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside-volatility shock reversal**
   - Defined as the negative lagged ratio of 5-day downside volatility to 60-day downside volatility.
   - Motivation: assets experiencing unusually large downside fluctuations may exhibit subsequent mean reversion.

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-10-04

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside-volatility shock reversal**
   - Defined as the negative lagged ratio of 5-day downside volatility to 60-day downside volatility.
   - Motivation: assets experiencing unusually large downside fluctuations may exhibit subsequent mean reversion.
   - The initial downside-volatility formulation had insufficient usable observations because many assets lacked enough nonzero downside-return history.

2. **Downside semivolatility shock reversal**
   - Defined as:
     \[
     -\frac{\sqrt{\operatorname{mean}(\min(r,0)^2)_{10d}}}
     {\sqrt{\operatorname{mean}(\min(r,0)^2)_{60d}}}
     \]
     lagged by one day.
   - Tested against 5-, 10-, and 20-day forward returns.
   - This formulation improved coverage and avoided the sparse downside-observation problem.

3. **Volume-confirmed price-shock reversal**
   - Defined as lagged negative daily return multiplied by abnormal volume relative to its 20-day median.
   - Motivation: high-volume selloffs may contain stronger reversal information than ordinary price shocks.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | IC dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Downside-volatility shock reversal | 10d | 0.020408 | 0.073915 | 7 | 8.00 | 53.33% | 0.136523 | Failed; insufficient sample |
| Downside semivolatility shock reversal | 5d | -0.007368 | -0.023955 | 894 | 11.09 | 73.93% | 0.112602 | Failed |
| Downside semivolatility shock reversal | 10d | -0.001911 | -0.005995 | 883 | 11.10 | 73.99% | 0.112602 | Failed |
| Downside semivolatility shock reversal | 20d | -0.010419 | -0.031761 | 874 | 11.10 | 74.01% | 0.112602 | Failed |
| Volume-confirmed price-shock reversal | 10d | -0.011198 | -0.025528 | 1,023* | 8.95 | 59.69% | 0.236336 | Failed |

\*The volume-confirmed factor generated many constant or undefined cross-sectional observations because of sparse/constant volume data for several synthetic instruments. Its reported metrics are therefore conservative and unsuitable for admission.

The benchmark admission gates are absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840. No candidate met both gates with adequate historical coverage and stable observations.

#### Regime observations

- Downside semivolatility reversal showed strong recent behavior but poor full-history robustness:
  - 5d recent 180-day IC/ICIR: **0.088475 / 0.288401**
  - 10d recent 180-day IC/ICIR: **0.081371 / 0.264836**
  - 20d recent 180-day IC/ICIR: **0.071023 / 0.249301**
- However, 2026 and 2027–2028 results were generally negative, and the full-period results failed decisively.
- The volume-confirmed factor had high turnover and inadequate cross-sectional coverage, with frequent constant-signal warnings.

### Persistence Actions

- **No new factors persisted.**
- No candidate satisfied the full-sample IC/ICIR admission criteria with sufficient robustness.
- No live-account, backtest, or step operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The factor library remains unchanged from the prior cycle.

Existing residual-reversal and related reversal factors remain historically effective but should continue to receive capped ensemble weights because recent predictive performance has weakened. The downside semivolatility candidate is retained only as a research artifact and is not effective.

### Plans

- Continue monitoring downside semivolatility reversal during the current high-stress regime.
- Test smoother downside-risk measures, such as 20/120-day downside-volatility ratios or downside-volatility changes rather than levels.
- Investigate volume data quality and restrict volume-based factors to instruments with demonstrably nonconstant volume histories.
- Revalidate existing residual and trend factors on the next cycle, with particular attention to recent 180-day IC drift and redundancy with the current ensemble.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-17']
r=P.pct_change(); dn=r.clip(upper=0)
v20=np.sqrt((dn**2).rolling(20,min_periods=12).mean()); v120=np.sqrt((dn**2).rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())
# A lagged downside-risk acceleration signal: buy assets whose recent downside semivolatility has accelerated less / is relatively calm.
f=(-(v20/v120-1)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('candidate downside semivolatility acceleration reversal; dates',P.index.min(),P.index.max())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-10-17','2029-10-17')),('r180',slice('2029-04-17','2029-10-17'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291018_downside_accel_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-17']
r=P.pct_change(); trough=P.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
# Recovery from 60d trough, volatility normalized, lagged.
f=(np.log(P/trough)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
print('candidate drawdown recovery / volatility')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-10-17','2029-10-17')),('r180',slice('2029-04-17','2029-10-17'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

    p=x['close'].astype(float); r=p.pct_change()
    trough=p.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()

    f=(np.log(p/trough)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-10-18

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside semivolatility acceleration**
   - Defined as the lagged negative change in downside semivolatility:
     \[
     -\left(\frac{\sigma^-_{20}}{\sigma^-_{120}}-1\right)
     \]
   - Motivation: identify assets whose downside-risk conditions have not recently deteriorated, potentially favoring more stable assets.
   - Tested at 5-, 10-, and 20-trading-day horizons.

2. **Volatility-normalized drawdown recovery**
   - Defined as lagged log-distance from the 60-day trough divided by 20-day return volatility:
     \[
     \frac{\log(P_t/\min(P_{t-60:t}))}{\sigma_{20}}
     \]
   - Motivation: distinguish assets recovering efficiently from drawdowns from assets remaining close to stressed lows.
   - Tested at 5-, 10-, and 20-day horizons.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | IC dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Downside semivolatility acceleration | 5d | -0.014263 | -0.048159 | 844 | 11.55 | 77.02% | 0.090713 | Failed |
| Downside semivolatility acceleration | 10d | -0.008226 | -0.026350 | 1,049 | 11.45 | 76.30% | 0.090713 | Failed |
| Downside semivolatility acceleration | 20d | -0.003395 | -0.010814 | 829 | 11.56 | 77.09% | 0.090713 | Failed |
| Volatility-normalized drawdown recovery | 5d | -0.041747 | -0.133000 | 836 | 11.06 | 73.72% | 0.051291 | Failed |
| Volatility-normalized drawdown recovery | 10d | -0.038471 | -0.119442 | 831 | 11.06 | 73.72% | 0.051291 | Failed |
| Volatility-normalized drawdown recovery | 20d | -0.037024 | -0.119444 | 821 | 11.06 | 73.72% | 0.051291 | Failed |

The admission thresholds were absolute daily IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily ICIR ≥ **0.0840**. Neither factor passed both thresholds on the full validation history.

Recent performance was materially better, particularly over the latest 180 days:

- Downside semivolatility acceleration, 10d: IC **0.071684**, ICIR **0.246159**
- Drawdown recovery, 10d: IC **0.148168**, ICIR **0.467362**
- Drawdown recovery, 20d: IC **0.219873**, ICIR **0.937782**

However, both showed substantially negative performance during earlier regimes, especially 2027–2028. The recent improvement was therefore treated as regime-specific rather than sufficient for admission.

The drawdown-stress artifact showed a maximum absolute signal correlation of approximately **0.912237** with `miner_1_20281228_recovery_quality_signal.csv`, indicating significant redundancy with an existing recovery-style factor.

### Persistence Actions

- No factors persisted.
- Both candidates failed the full-history IC/ICIR admission gates.
- Signal artifacts were retained for future regime monitoring:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20291018_downside_accel_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20291018_drawdown_recovery_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20291018_drawdown_stress_signal.csv`
- No live-account, backtest, or step operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The effective factor library remains unchanged. Existing trend, leadership, volatility, residual-reversal, and defensive factors remain available according to the latest ensemble and validation records. The newly tested downside-risk and drawdown-recovery candidates are not effective.

### Plans

- Revalidate existing effective factors for recent predictive decay.
- Continue monitoring the strong recent drawdown-recovery signal, but test regime-conditioned or breadth-gated variants before considering admission.
- Avoid adding highly correlated recovery factors unless they provide independent signal information.
- Explore lower-correlation cross-asset factors using macro-regime conditioning, dispersion, and relative-strength transitions.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-10-31']
r=P.pct_change()
# directional efficiency: net movement relative to total path movement, lagged one day
f=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum().abs()/r.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()) * np.sign(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum())
f=f.shift(1)
print('range efficiency signed; dates',P.index.min(),P.index.max())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-11-01','2029-10-31')),('r180',slice('2029-05-01','2029-10-31'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291101_range_efficiency_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-11-01

### Explored Factors

1. **Signed range-efficiency factor**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \operatorname{sign}\left(\sum_{20d} r\right)
     \times
     \frac{\left|\sum_{20d} r\right|}{\sum_{20d}|r|}
     \]
   - The signal was lagged by one trading day to prevent look-ahead bias.
   - Motivation: identify assets exhibiting persistent directional movement rather than choppy price paths.
   - Tested at 5-, 10-, and 20-trading-day forward horizons.

2. **Volatility-scaled breakout distance**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{P_{t-1}/\max(P_{t-120:t-1})-1}{\sigma_{20,t-1}}
     \]
   - Motivation: evaluate whether assets trading above or below their prior 120-day high, after volatility normalization, predict future returns.
   - Tested at 5-, 10-, and 20-trading-day horizons.

### Validation Results

Validation used the full available history through 2029-10-31, with the 15-instrument universe and at least 8 valid instruments per cross-sectional observation.

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | IC dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Signed range efficiency | 5d | -0.016104 | -0.054259 | 846 | 11.06 | 73.71% | 0.055650 | Failed |
| Signed range efficiency | 10d | -0.005439 | -0.017975 | 841 | 11.06 | 73.71% | 0.055650 | Failed |
| Signed range efficiency | 20d | -0.001244 | -0.004063 | 831 | 11.06 | 73.72% | 0.055650 | Failed |
| Vol-scaled breakout distance | 5d | -0.046764 | -0.147224 | 846 | 11.06 | 73.71% | 0.045633 | Failed |
| Vol-scaled breakout distance | 10d | -0.057072 | -0.177081 | 841 | 11.06 | 73.71% | 0.045633 | Failed |
| Vol-scaled breakout distance | 20d | -0.091729 | -0.296682 | 831 | 11.06 | 73.72% | 0.045633 | Failed |

Admission thresholds were absolute daily IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily ICIR ≥ **0.0840**. Neither candidate passed both gates.

#### Regime observations

Signed range efficiency showed substantial recent improvement:

- 10d horizon, trailing 360 days: IC **0.050634**, ICIR **0.174544**
- 10d horizon, trailing 180 days: IC **0.054322**, ICIR **0.187613**
- 20d horizon, trailing 180 days: IC **0.089935**, ICIR **0.312361**

However, the factor was materially negative during 2027–2028, with 10d IC **-0.041860** and ICIR **-0.134903**. The recent improvement is therefore regime-dependent and insufficient for full-history admission.

The volatility-scaled breakout factor was persistently negative over the full sample and failed in every tested horizon. Its strongest negative result was at 20d, with IC **-0.091729** and ICIR **-0.296682**. It does not appear suitable in its current directional form.

`max_abs_library_correlation` was not computed for these failed candidates because neither produced an admission-eligible factor. Signal artifacts were nevertheless generated for possible future analysis.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- Both candidates failed the benchmark-wide IC/ICIR admission gates.
- Signal artifacts retained:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20291101_range_efficiency_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20291101_breakout_quality_signal.csv`
- No live-account, backtest, or step operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The factor library remains unchanged. Existing effective factors include trend persistence, leadership/trend, residual and volatility-adjusted reversal, drawdown-weighted reversal, relative reversal, range-extreme reversal, volume-confirmed reversal, downside-adjusted reversal, and stress-residual reversal variants.

Recent effective examples include:

- `miner_2_20290920_stress_residual_reversal_10d`: IC **0.069279**, ICIR **0.227309**, validated 2029-09-20
- `miner_1_20290809_residual_vol_reversal_10d`: IC **0.041486**, ICIR **0.142358**, validated 2029-08-09
- `miner_1_20290712_downside_adjusted_reversal_10d`: IC **0.034630**, ICIR **0.116824**, validated 2029-07-12
- `miner_2_20290322_range_extreme_reversal_5d`: IC **0.064060**, ICIR **0.225933**, validated 2029-03-22

### Plans

- Investigate whether signed range efficiency can be made more robust through explicit volatility- or dispersion-regime conditioning.
- Explore the breakout factor in the opposite, mean-reversion direction, given its consistently negative predictive sign.
- Test lower-correlation cross-asset signals based on relative dispersion, macro stress transitions, and leadership breadth.
- Continue monitoring the recent positive regime for range efficiency without admitting it until full-history stability improves.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-14']
r=P.pct_change()
# Mean-reversion to prior 120d high: inverse volatility-scaled breakout distance, fully lagged.
hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
f=-(P.shift(1)/hi-1)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)
print('inverse vol-scaled breakout; dates',P.index.min(),P.index.max())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-11-15','2029-11-14')),('r180',slice('2029-05-15','2029-11-14'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291115_inverse_breakout_signal.csv',index=False)
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291115_inverse_breakout_ic.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-28']
r=P.pct_change()
# Reversal of acceleration: assets whose recent 10d return deteriorated versus preceding 10d,
# normalized by lagged 20d volatility. All inputs are known at t-1.
recent=P.pct_change(10).shift(1)
prior=P.pct_change(20).shift(1)-recent
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
f=-(recent-prior)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)
rows_by={}
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic; rows_by[h]=R
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-11-29','2029-11-28')),('r180',slice('2029-05-29','2029-11-28'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
rows_by[10].to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291129_drawdown_accel_ic.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-28']
r=P.pct_change(); trough=P.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
# Distance recovered from 60d trough, volatility-normalized, fully lagged.
f=(np.log(P/trough)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; rows=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('h',h,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-11-29','2029-11-28')),('r180',slice('2029-05-29','2029-11-28'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291129_drawdown_recovery_ic.csv')
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291129_drawdown_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-11-29

### Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-normalized drawdown acceleration reversal**
   - Construction:
     \[
     -\frac{R_{t-9:t-1}-\left(R_{t-19:t-1}-R_{t-9:t-1}\right)}{\sigma_{20,t-1}}
     \]
   - Higher values favor assets whose recent 10-day performance deteriorated relative to the preceding 10 days, normalized by lagged volatility.
   - Tested using 5-, 10-, and 20-trading-day forward returns.
   - Inputs were lagged to avoid look-ahead bias.

2. **Volatility-normalized recovery from 60-day trough**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{\log(P_{t-1}/\min(P_{t-60:t-1}))}{\sigma_{20,t-1}}
     \]
   - Higher values favor assets that have recovered farther from their recent trough on a volatility-adjusted basis.
   - Tested over 5-, 10-, and 20-day horizons.

   - Existing factor was revalidated through 2029-11-28.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-12']
r=P.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
# Single interpretable idea: volatility-normalized distance below lagged rolling highs,
# a contrarian continuation signal. All extrema and volatility are lagged.
rows=[]
for look in [30,60,90]:
 high=P.rolling(look,min_periods=max(15,look//2)).max().shift(1)
 f=np.log(P.shift(1)/high)/vol
 fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
 rr=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rr.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(rr,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('look',look,'obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-12-13','2029-12-12')),('r180',slice('2029-06-16','2029-12-12'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
 if look==60:
  print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
  R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_high_distance_ic.csv')
  f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_high_distance_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-12']
r=P.pct_change(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1); f=-(P.shift(1)/hi-1)/vol.replace(0,np.nan); fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
print('obs',len(x),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('r360',slice('2028-12-13','2029-12-12')),('r180',slice('2029-06-16','2029-12-12'))]:
 y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6))
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
for h in [5,20]:
 F=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],F.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(vals); print('decay',h,round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6))
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_inverse_breakout_ic.csv'); f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_inverse_breakout_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:'2030-01-23']
r=P.pct_change(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
f=-(P.shift(1)/hi-1)/vol.replace(0,np.nan)
def run(h):
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; out=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: out.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print('H',h,'obs',len(x),'range',R.index.min().date(),R.index.max().date(),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
 for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('2029',slice('2029','2029')),('r360',slice('2029-01-24','2030-01-23')),('r180',slice('2029-07-28','2030-01-23'))]:
  y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
 return R
R=run(10); run(5); run(20)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'rows',int(f.notna().sum().sum()))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300124_inverse_breakout_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut='2030-02-06'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
r=P.pct_change(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
# Conditional recovery reversal: inverse breakout signal is active only when lagged 60d trend is positive,
# avoiding persistent downtrends while retaining mean reversion in established uptrends.
trend=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1
gate=(trend>0).astype(float)
f=(-(P.shift(1)/hi-1)/vol.replace(0,np.nan))*gate
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
out=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: out.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
print('obs',len(x),'range',R.index.min().date(),R.index.max().date(),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('2029',slice('2029','2029')),('r360',slice('2029-02-06','2030-02-06')),('r180',slice('2029-08-11','2030-02-06'))]:
 y=R.loc[q,'ic']; print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'rows',int(f.notna().sum().sum()))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300207_conditional_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300207_conditional_recovery_ic.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut='2030-02-06'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
r=P.pct_change(); raw=-(P.shift(1)/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)-1)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1); tr=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
for name,f in [('raw',raw),('gate',raw*(tr>0)),('boost',raw*(1+4*tr.clip(lower=0))),('soft',raw*(1+tr.clip(lower=0)*10))]:
 out=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna(); c=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic if len(z)>=8 else np.nan
  if np.isfinite(c):out.append((d,c,len(z)))
 R=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
 print(name,len(x),round(x.mean(),6),round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),round(R.n.mean(),2),round((x>0).mean(),4),'r360',round(R.loc['2029-02-06':,'ic'].mean(),6))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut='2030-02-06'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
r=P.pct_change(); base=-(P.shift(1)/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)-1)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1); tr=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1
f=base*(1+10*tr.clip(lower=0)); fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1; out=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna();
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(c):out.append((d,c,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
print('obs',len(x),'range',R.index.min().date(),R.index.max().date(),'avgN',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
for nm,q in [('2026',slice('2026','2026')),('2027-28',slice('2027','2028')),('2029',slice('2029','2029')),('r360',slice('2029-02-06','2030-02-06')),('r180',slice('2029-08-11','2030-02-06'))]:
 y=R.loc[q,'ic'];print(nm,len(y),round(y.mean(),6),round(y.mean()/y.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan)
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'rows',int(f.notna().sum().sum()))
f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300207_recovery_boost_signal.csv',index=False);R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300207_recovery_boost_ic.csv')

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2030-02-07

### Explored Factors

1. **Trend-conditioned inverse breakout reversal**
   - Base signal: inverse 120-day breakout distance, normalized by lagged 20-day volatility.
   - Applied only when the lagged 60-day trend was positive.
   - Result: failed admission gates with IC **0.014251** and ICIR **0.048380**.

2. **Positive-trend recovery boost**
   - Signal:
     \[
     \frac{-(P_{t-1}/\max(P_{t-120:t-1})-1)}{\sigma_{20,t-1}}
     \times \left(1+10\max\left(\frac{P_{t-1}}{P_{t-61}}-1,0\right)\right)
     \]
   - Uses only lagged prices and volatility.
   - Rewards recovery potential more strongly when the asset has a positive 60-day trend.

   - Passed the numerical gate with IC **0.031412** and ICIR **0.099430**, but was not persisted because it duplicates the existing inverse-breakout factor family.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut='2030-02-20'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
r=P.pct_change(); lag=r.shift(1)
# Persistence-adjusted trend: 60d return normalized by 20d risk, weighted by fraction of positive days.
f=(P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)*(lag.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean().shift(0)>0).astype(float)
# use continuous persistence rather than binary, bounded to avoid outliers
p=(lag.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/lag.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()).clip(-2,2)
f=((P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1))*(1+0.5*p)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
out=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna();
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(c): out.append((d,c,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
print('dates',len(x),'start',R.index.min(),'end',R.index.max(),'avg_n',round(R.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(R.n.mean()/15,4))
print('IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover_proxy',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
for label,sl in [('2026',('2026-01-01','2026-12-31')),('2027_28',('2027-01-01','2028-12-31')),('2029',('2029-01-01','2029-12-31')),('r360',('2029-02-20','2030-02-20')),('r180',('2029-08-20','2030-02-20'))]:
 q=R.loc[sl[0]:sl[1],'ic'].dropna(); print(label,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1; oo=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: oo.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(oo).dropna(); print('decay',h,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6))
# artifact
sig=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); sig.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300221_persistence_trend_signal.csv',index=False)
R.reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300221_persistence_trend_ic.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index()
# strictly lagged signal; 10 sessions forward return
r=P.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
raw=-(P.shift(1)/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)-1)/vol
trend=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1
f=raw*(1+4*trend.clip(lower=0))
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(ic): rows.append((d,ic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
# use all available history but report online-safe endpoint
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300307_recovery_boost4_ic.csv')
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300307_recovery_boost4_signal.csv')
x=R.ic
print('endpoint',P.index.max().date(),'dates',len(R),'start',R.index.min().date(),'end',R.index.max().date(),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.mean()/15)
print('ic',x.mean(),'icir',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean(),'turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
for label,sub in [('2026',R.loc['2026']),('2027-28',R.loc['2027':'2028']),('2029',R.loc['2029']),('recent360',R.tail(360)),('recent180',R.tail(180))]:
 print(label,len(sub),sub.ic.mean(),sub.ic.mean()/sub.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(sub)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1; q=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(q).dropna(); print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; CUT='2030-03-06'

r=P.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
raw=-(P.shift(1)/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)-1)/vol
trend=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1; f=raw*(1+4*trend.clip(lower=0)); fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(ic): rows.append((d,ic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300307_recovery_boost4_ic.csv'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300307_recovery_boost4_signal.csv')
print('endpoint',P.index.max().date(),'dates',len(R),'start',R.index.min().date(),'end',R.index.max().date(),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.mean()/15)
print('ic',x.mean(),'icir',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean(),'turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
for label,sub in [('2026',R.loc['2026']),('2027-28',R.loc['2027':'2028']),('2029',R.loc['2029']),('recent360',R.tail(360)),('recent180',R.tail(180))]: print(label,len(sub),sub.ic.mean(),sub.ic.mean()/sub.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(sub)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1; q=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(q).dropna(); print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; CUT='2030-03-20'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:CUT]
r=P.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
raw=-(P.shift(1)/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max().shift(1)-1)/vol
trend=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1; f=raw*(1+4*trend.clip(lower=0)); fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(ic): rows.append((d,ic,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300321_recovery_boost4_reval_ic.csv'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300321_recovery_boost4_reval_signal.csv')
print('endpoint',P.index.max().date(),'dates',len(R),'start',R.index.min().date(),'end',R.index.max().date(),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.mean()/15)
print('full',x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean(),'turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
for label,sub in [('2026',R.loc['2026']),('2027-28',R.loc['2027':'2028']),('2029',R.loc['2029']),('2030',R.loc['2030']),('recent360',R.tail(360)),('recent180',R.tail(180))]: print(label,len(sub),sub.ic.mean(),sub.ic.mean()/sub.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(sub)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1; q=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(q).dropna(); print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; CUT='2030-03-20'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:CUT]
r=P.pct_change(); v=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
# lagged medium-term trend persistence, volatility adjusted and bounded to reduce crypto domination
mom=P.shift(1)/P.shift(61)-1
f=(mom/v).clip(-8,8)
rows=[]; fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(q): rows.append((d,q,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300321_riskadj_mom_ic.csv'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300321_riskadj_mom_signal.csv')
print('dates',len(R),'start',R.index.min().date(),'end',R.index.max().date(),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.mean()/15)
print('full',x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean(),'turn',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
for lab,s in [('2026',R.loc['2026']),('2027-28',R.loc['2027':'2028']),('2029',R.loc['2029']),('2030',R.loc['2030']),('r360',R.tail(360)),('r180',R.tail(180))]: print(lab,len(s),s.ic.mean(),s.ic.mean()/s.ic.std(ddof=1))
for h in [5,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1;q=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; CUT='2030-04-03'
P=pd.concat({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A},axis=1).sort_index().loc[:CUT]
r=P.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().shift(1)
# Relative 20-day reversal: asset return versus contemporaneous cross-asset median,
# scaled by own lagged volatility; positive values indicate stronger recent relative loss.
ret20=P.shift(1)/P.shift(21)-1
rel=ret20.sub(ret20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
f=(-rel/vol).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[]
for d in P.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  if np.isfinite(q):rows.append((d,q,len(z)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); x=R.ic
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300404_relative_reversal_signal.csv');R.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300404_relative_reversal_ic.csv')
print('dates',len(R),'start',R.index.min().date(),'end',R.index.max().date(),'avg_n',R.n.mean(),'coverage',R.n.mean()/15)
print('full',x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean(),'turn',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
for lab,s in [('2026',R.loc['2026']),('2027-28',R.loc['2027':'2028']),('2029',R.loc['2029']),('2030',R.loc['2030']),('r360',R.tail(360)),('r180',R.tail(180))]: print(lab,len(s),s.ic.mean(),s.ic.mean()/s.std(ddof=1) if len(s)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1;q=[]
 for d in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],fw2.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(q).dropna();print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    x=get_index_daily_data(s, days=2600)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.set_index('date').sort_index(); D[s]=x['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill()
r=np.log(p).diff()
# candidate: intermediate trend persistence, normalized by lagged vol, rewarded when short and medium trends agree
r20=np.log(p/p.shift(20)); r60=np.log(p/p.shift(60)); v20=r.rolling(20).std().shift(1); v60=r.rolling(60).std().shift(1)
f=(r20/v20)*(1+0.5*np.sign(r20)*np.sign(r60))
f=f.clip(-8,8)
# alternative single idea: volatility compression adjusted medium momentum
# compression ratio lagged, favors momentum when short vol below long vol
f2=(r60/v60)*(1+(v60/(v20+1e-12)-1).clip(-1,1)*0.5).clip(-8,8)

def evalfac(z,name):
  rows=[]
  for d in z.index:
    if d not in r.index: continue
    fut=np.log(p.shift(-10)/p).loc[d]
    a=z.loc[d]; ok=a.notna()&fut.notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:
      ic=a[ok].rank().corr(fut[ok].rank())
      rows.append((d,ic,ok.sum()))
  q=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
  ic=q.ic.mean(); ir=ic/q.ic.std(ddof=1); n=len(q)
  for k in [180,360]:
    sub=q.tail(k); print(name,'recent',k,sub.ic.mean() if len(sub) else np.nan)
  # turnover rank changes daily
  ranks=z.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
  print(name,'dates',n,'avgN',q.n.mean(),'coverage',q.n.mean()/15,'IC',ic,'ICIR',ir,'hit',(q.ic>0).mean(),'turn',turn)
  print(name,'5d/20d decay:', end=' ')
  for h in [5,20]:
    rr=[]
    for d in z.index:
      fut=np.log(p.shift(-h)/p).loc[d]; a=z.loc[d]; ok=a.notna()&fut.notna()
      if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(a[ok].rank().corr(fut[ok].rank()))
    print(h, np.nanmean(rr),end='; ')
  print()
evalfac(f,'agreement_momentum'); evalfac(f2,'compression_momentum')
